scope: montri-th/CityMETER public static catalog; does not change the map application or upstream data

authority.coverage: Catalog/detail writing, grouped masonry, latest LDS0.9.7 UI color projection and discovery; retained public shell behavior/media

tasks.action: Read current public data view and primary source references; distinguish provider, publisher, reference candidate, period, units, denominator and missingness.
tasks.doneWhen: Every changed factual claim has an inspectable source or is explicitly unknown.

tasks.action: Edit src/catalog.json in TH/EN, preserving team intent, source facts, stable IDs and map URLs. Write executiveSummary lead, sectionTitle, reading, note, two questions and takeaway from the same record evidence. Preserve the exact data grain, denominator and material interpretation limits.
tasks.doneWhen: No invented coverage, freshness, rights, behaviour or business outcome; branch shares have a stated subset and demand proxies stay proxies.

tasks.action: Assign each record one of Land/Location/Living and exactly one semantic subgroup. Preserve subgroup order and canonical EN title order shared across locales; Flood is recurrent, observed, DWR forecast, Google forecast. Keep 24 headings scalable; no fourth Local Decisions pillar.
tasks.doneWhen: All 43 records have valid subgroup, stable IDs and map URLs; counts 13/16/14 and no empty public subgroup.

tasks.action: Sync only the reviewed public Landom contributor projection and review its diff; do not infer candidate attribution or consent.
tasks.doneWhen: Each displayed credit joins an explicit public module mapping and a usable public profile URL.

tasks.action: Run npm ci, npm run build and npm run check. Build all 43 local static SVG QR codes from each exact map URL; decode them independently. Do not edit generated files.
tasks.doneWhen: Deterministic build, semantic/search checks and immutable-input hash checks pass.

tasks.action: Inspect actual TH/EN content at 390 and 1440 CSS px, plus breakpoints 768 and 1100 CSS px. Verify 3 dedicated group lanes at wide widths, independent card heights, native source disclosures and QR, filter/reset/empty/same-hash navigation, menu/language/theme, retained decision/share/reel, keyboard and reduced-motion/observer-failure final visibility. Read summary pages in both locales at narrow/desktop, 150% Thai text and 200% native page zoom. Test direct map bypass, top/bottom actions, exact return anchor, four platform handoffs, copy failure fallback and no-JS selectable URL.
tasks.doneWhen: No overflow, fake preview, decorative bracket/rail, missing credit/name, dead control or stale count.

tasks.action: Open a focused PR with evidence, changed behaviour, test result and responsive screenshots; require quality CI.
tasks.doneWhen: The exact commit and generated diff have been reviewed; CI does not deploy a PR.

tasks.action: After authorized merge, inspect GitHub Pages provider/source/build status, confirm deployed commit, fetch exact public artifacts and compare hashes, then check user journeys on the public URLs.
tasks.doneWhen: Provider attestation and public bytes agree with the reviewed release; push success alone is insufficient.

noInference: count share is not sales or revenue share
no matched license record is not no license
data-review date is not ingestion time
public credit is not inferred personal consent
guardrails.localeInsight: Contextual prior only; crosswalk locale_id to verified municipality/community/service boundary before aggregation; not official population, eligibility, statutory boundary, risk or verified behaviour.
guardrails.releaseHistory: Preserve immutable public baseline and historical assets; do not treat older LDS documentation as current parallel authority.

catalog.wide: 3 dedicated masonry lanes Land/Location/Living at >= 1100 CSS px
catalog.medium: 2 group lanes at 768–1099 CSS px; do not intermix records
catalog.narrow: 1 sequential group lane below 768 CSS px
catalog.qr: local SVG actual mapUrl, 4-module quiet zone, M correction; static before hydration
catalog.motion: preview-only once arrival and bounded state feedback; all content/actions visible without motion
catalog.filterReset: Reset button clears query and restores all pillars; deleting only the search text retains the selected pillar.
catalog.readingFocus: Hover, keyboard focus or an open visible disclosure quiets sibling content; release on outside click, Escape, filtering or offscreen active card. No backdrop, scroll lock, tab-order change or intercepted direct action; print/forced colors remain fully visible.

required.reading: one concise evidence-based paragraph per locale
required.note: brief material reader limitation per locale

summary.path: existing localized datasets/<slug>/ routes; no additional reading layer
flow: catalog first action opens map directly
compact contributor links open public profiles
summary benefit, direct map and same-record preview
specific insight and concise material note
two questions and next action with map/contact links
native source disclosure with unchanged source fields and full limitations
contributors, actual-map QR, share and exact catalog return anchors

share.noJavaScript: real links plus selectable readonly canonical URL
share.enhancement: native navigator.share when available; clipboard copy with focus/select fallback
share.doesNot: send or post automatically; no prefilled contact context claim

summary.socialImage: Only the same record actual preview; conceptual/missing previews omit social image.
summary.limits: Concise material note in the visible article; unchanged full record.limitation retained in optional source disclosure.
summary.layout: Wide benefit/preview hero and 760px reading column; single column at <=940 CSS px. Dedicated src/styles/summary.css.
summary.metadata: Localized executiveSummary.lead is used in description, Open Graph and Twitter descriptions; identity graph remains @id/@type/name/url only.

precedence: valid stored lds-theme or legacy citymeter-theme
theme.storageFailure: valid query still works; system/light fallback otherwise

runtimeFixtures.environment: Node VM with a small DOM adapter and simulated media queries
covers: simulated reduced-motion preference and preference change
open disclosure retention and offscreen release
outside/Escape/filter cleanup without blocking native actions

osReducedMotion.claim: VM fixtures do not establish OS-level reduced-motion behavior.

verificationScope.chooserAndOperationalMap: Catalog checks do not establish dataset-switcher prototype or operational-map integration behavior.

summaryFixtures.scope: 86 initial HTML value/metadata/map/back/source/full-limit/credit/QR/share contracts; 8 VM theme precedence fixtures; 6 VM clipboard/native-share fixtures. Not completed posts or native OS share-panel validation.

ldsStaticCheck.wholePage: inherited legacy CSS color literals and shell color-mix remain outside a full conformance claim

discoveryModel.catalog: Concise grouped cards, real HTML links, native source disclosures and per-record operational QR handoff.
discoveryModel.detailPages: Existing stable localized URLs now contain concise executive summaries, two questions, reading guidance, exact source/period/scope/limitations and public credits in initial HTML; canonical/hreflang/sitemap kept in sync.
discoveryModel.operationalViews: Exact existing mapUrl, preserving dataset, example area and 3D route.
discoveryModel.qr: Mobile handoff to mapUrl; a QR-only page is not a replacement for useful indexable dataset content.

contributorProjection.joinContract: Every public catalog record has one explicit dataset-<slug> module key; hidden business-dynamics remains excluded.

existingBindingsRestored.scope: Existing owner-confirmed contribution; module binding restored.
